scenarios.name: Homepage Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays the product tagline, brief description, and primary call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Load the website homepage in a browser
steps.context: User lands on the site via search or direct link

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains the headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons
steps.context: REQ-1: Display product overview explaining MirDB's purpose

steps.description: Confirm that Get Started and GitHub links are present and clickable
steps.context: REQ-8: Link to GitHub repository for source code access

test_cases.expected: Hero section displays with headline containing 'MirDB' and 'Persistent Key-Value Store'
Get Started button is visible and links to getting-started section or documentation
GitHub button/link is visible and links to MirDB repository
Subheadline mentions memcached compatibility and persistence/durability

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the features section presents key MirDB capabilities including memcached protocol support, persistence, and LSM tree architecture

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate to the features section on the homepage
steps.context: REQ-2: Present key features

steps.description: Check that all key features are displayed in a grid or card layout
steps.context: Features should include memcached protocol, SSTables persistence, LSM tree architecture, and Rust performance

steps.description: Confirm each feature card has a title and description explaining the benefit
steps.context: Content should be accurate based on MirDB capabilities

test_cases.expected: Feature card displays information about memcached protocol compatibility
Feature card displays information about SSTable-based persistence
Feature card displays information about LSM tree architecture
Feature card mentions Rust implementation and high performance
Features are displayed in a grid layout (3-4 cards) with consistent styling

scenarios.name: Getting Started Guide
scenarios.description: Verify that the getting-started section provides clear installation and basic usage instructions

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate to the getting started section
steps.context: REQ-3: Provide getting-started guide with installation and basic usage instructions

steps.description: Check that installation steps are clearly documented
steps.context: Users should be able to install and run MirDB within 10 minutes

steps.description: Confirm that code examples are present and syntax-highlighted
steps.context: REQ-7: Provide code examples demonstrating common operations

test_cases.expected: Quick start section is visible with clear heading
Code block shows mirdb startup command (e.g., mirdb -c config.toml)
Code block shows basic SET/GET operations with expected responses
Code blocks have syntax highlighting and are properly formatted

steps.context: REQ-4: Display supported memcached commands

steps.description: Check that SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND commands are documented

steps.description: Check that GET and GETS commands are documented
steps.context: Retrieval commands for reading data

steps.description: Check that DELETE, INFO, MAJOR_COMPACTION commands are documented

test_cases.expected: SET command is documented with syntax and usage example
GET command is documented with syntax and usage example
DELETE command is documented with syntax and usage example
ADD command is documented
REPLACE command is documented
APPEND and PREPEND commands are documented
INFO command (MirDB-specific) is documented

steps.context: No horizontal scrolling, text readable

steps.description: Confirm buttons and links are tappable with appropriate sizing
steps.context: Touch targets should be at least 44x44px

steps.description: Scroll through entire page and verify all sections render correctly

test_cases.expected: Page loads without horizontal scroll, content fits viewport width
Hero text is readable, CTA buttons are full-width or appropriately sized
Feature cards stack vertically, each card is fully visible
Code blocks have horizontal scroll if needed, text is readable
Body text is at least 16px, headings are proportionally sized

scenarios.name: Performance - Page Load Time

steps.context: NFR-2: Page load time must be under 3 seconds

steps.description: Verify total page weight and individual resource sizes

test_cases.input: Load homepage on standard broadband connection
test_cases.expected: Page becomes interactive in under 3 seconds
Lighthouse performance score is 90 or higher
Total page weight is reasonable for content (ideally under 1MB)
JavaScript payload is minimal (Astro ships minimal JS by default)

steps.description: Check that all images have appropriate alt attributes
steps.context: Alt text for images and diagrams

test_cases.input: Run automated accessibility audit (axe or similar)
test_cases.expected: No critical accessibility violations detected
Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)

test_cases.input: Navigate site using only Tab key
test_cases.expected: All interactive elements are focusable and have visible focus indicators
Headings follow proper hierarchy (h1, h2, h3) without skipping levels
All meaningful images have descriptive alt text
